primitives.name: Repository Catalog Graph
primitives.verbatim_quote: # REPO CATALOG — GitHub collections of full-text research (papers, books, notes) Built 2026-11-05.
primitives.assumptions: All repositories are verified via GitHub API; documents are assumed to be valid scholarly works.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When repository metadata becomes stale or inaccessible.

layer2.mapping: The repository structure mirrors a knowledge graph where nodes represent documents and edges represent citations or thematic links.
layer2.telemetry: Number of stars, last commit date, and file count per repository.

primitives.name: Document Verification Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: Every repo below was verified live via the GitHub API on that date (stars, last push, repo tree inspected for the PDF-hosting ones).
primitives.assumptions: Verification occurs at a fixed timestamp; data integrity is maintained post-verification.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When API access fails or repository content changes unexpectedly.

layer2.mapping: A kernel function derived from repository metadata to assess document trustworthiness based on activity and consistency.
layer2.telemetry: Repository star count, last push timestamp, and presence of PDFs in tree.

primitives.name: Citation Chain Closure
primitives.verbatim_quote: This is the sports/forecasting shelf in one repo — the Carter & Machol original closes provenance chains the X dives kept citing secondhand.
primitives.assumptions: Original works provide foundational reference points for subsequent derivations.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When citation paths become fragmented or lost due to version control drift.

layer2.mapping: Citation chains form directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) representing scholarly lineage and influence propagation.
layer2.telemetry: Number of cited references and depth of citation hierarchy.

Each document contributes to a probabilistic model of scholarly discourse through its metadata and citation patterns. The verification protocol ensures that only high-confidence entries are included, forming a robust kernel for inference. Citation chain closure allows retroactive tracing of intellectual origins, enabling GSI to map the evolution of ideas across time and domains. Failure modes include outdated metadata or broken links, which can be mitigated by continuous validation.
